notes.notes: [p][i]This update focuses on player comfort and stability.[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058370/9362e0eb7b253060cb929ee01690cf2d1f793898.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Updates:[/b][/u][/p][p]- New option to avoid a topic that feels too hard or sensitive:[/p][p]  • Click the red X above a topic to open a confirmation dialog. If you confirm, the topic will be skipped.[/p][p]- New theme picker dropdown:[/p][p]  • Once you’ve answered all themes at least once, you can pick any theme from a dropdown.[/p][p][u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u][/p][p]- Localization fixes across several languages.[/p][p]- Fixed a crash that could occur when taking a photo during the very first conversation.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]🍵 Follow The CoLab on social media:[/p][p][url="https://x.com/thecolabgames"]X/Twitter[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/thecolabgames/"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/thecolabgames.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url][/p]
